findings.F1: The tested fade is absent inside the falling-calm profile: on the 3-day grid (folds B, C), scaled up days of 0.3 to 1 usual daily moves are followed by an unusual 3-day move of +0.29 % (t 0.40, 121 cases), and of 1 to 2 moves by -2.50 % (t -2.31, 32 cases); the size reads -0.02 % per case (t -0.05, 483 days), against a 0.19 % cost per trade.
findings.F2: Inside the profile, down days look like they continue rather than rebound, but the effect is not graded and so is not usable as an idea. Down days of 1 to 2 usual moves are followed by -2.72 % (t -2.68, 69 cases). Across all profile down days the continuation is +1.51 % (t 1.99 per day, 124 days). The size-weighted version gives t 1.34. The slope of continuation on the fall's size is 0.0004 (t 0.06, 273 cases). The sign changes across windows (w13 +6.3 %, w18 -6.9 %) and across coins (t from 0.11 to 2.29).
findings.F3: Outside the profile the shapes do not line up from one size bucket to the next. Down days of 1 to 2 usual moves rebound by +1.98 % (t 2.31, 155 cases). Up days of 0.3 to 1 moves fall by -0.87 % (t -2.33, 396 cases). The next bucket up, 1 to 2 moves, is flat at +0.19 % (t 0.26).
findings.F4: Scaled momentum is positive but cannot be told from chance. The 20-day return in swing units times the next 3-day unusual move has t 1.43 (256 days), and is positive in 9 of 12 windows. The 5-day version has t 1.79 (425 days).
findings.F5: No other angle produced a monotone pattern. The 20-day return quintiles give -0.84 %, -0.98 %, +0.33 %, +1.10 % (t 2.87) and +0.65 %, which is not monotone. Close position within the day's range ranges from t -2.21 to t +1.26 with no order. Range quintiles all have |t| < 1.6. Next-day weekday effects all have |t| < 1.75, the largest being Friday at +0.36 %. The book's daily mean ranges from -0.12 % to +0.07 % by window.

no_ideas: I tested more than twenty angles (size of scaled moves in and out of the profile, 60-day and 20-day trend, close position, daily range, weekday, window, coin, graded continuation and 5- and 20-day momentum); the few cells near |t| 2.3–2.9 are isolated buckets with no grading, they change sign across windows and coins, and they do not stand out above what that many looks would give by chance.
